text: dsh-download-file 是一个 DSH 工具插件，为 Agent 提供从 URL 下载文件并保存到本地磁盘的能力。它在 DSH 的 tools 接口注册 download_file，接收必填 URL 和可选的 save_path、overwrite 参数；省略路径时使用工作目录，并根据 URL 推导文件名。下载以流方式写入，支持文本与二进制内容，返回保存路径、字节数和文本预览；目标已存在时默认跳过，也可显式选择覆盖。适合需要把远程文件取到 DSH 工作目录中的场景。无需配置 API 密钥或外部账户；运行时按用户提供的 URL 发起请求并在本机写入文件。

dsh-download-file adds a DSH tool that streams a file from a supplied URL to local disk. It accepts an optional save path and overwrite flag, skips existing files by default, and returns the saved path, byte count, and text preview. No API key or account is required.
想把一个 URL 指向的文件直接保存到 DSH 工作目录。
I need to download a file from a URL and save it on the local disk.
如何下载远程二进制文件，同时保留原始字节？
dsh-download-file 的功能「下载并保存文件」：通过 download_file 接收文件 URL，可选指定保存路径和是否覆盖；文件流式写入本地，返回保存位置、字节数及文本预览，已有目标默认跳过。
dsh-download-file 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 23 天；提交数 3；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-download-file README · dsh-download-file：**[English](README.en.md) | 中文**

一个 DSH 插件，给 Agent 加一个 `download_file` 工具：把任意 URL（内网 GitLab、公网 GitHub 等）的文件下载到本地磁盘，文本、二进制都行，下载完还会把文件开头几行预览给你看。纯 ESM、零依赖、无需构建，Windows / Linux / macOS 通用。

dsh-download-file README · 目的：某天，我打开 DSH（0.2.1-rc2）开了一个全新对话：

> 下载 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nihui/ruapu/refs/heads/master/ruapu.h

DSH 回了一句：`Error: spawn EPERM`。

我重开一个会话，给工作目录开了「完全权限」。

DSH 说：`ruapu 是 nihui 的项目，我直接尝试下载。`

过了 2 分钟，还没下完。挺捉急的。

所以就有了这个插件——**不需要工作目录的完全权限，5 秒内搞定下载**。

dsh-download-file README · 安装：命令行方式：

```sh
dsh-download-file README · 从本地目录安装：dsh plugin --profile <profile> add file:./dsh-download-file

dsh-download-file README · 或发布到 npm 后按包名安装：dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-download-file
```

GUI 方式：DSH 桌面版 → 插件 → 填入 "https://github.com/zchrissirhcz/dsh-download-file"

section: 或发布到 npm 后按包名安装

text:
dsh-download-file README · 在会话中：准确的给出 URL， 下载速度是最快的：

```
下载 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nihui/ruapu/refs/heads/master/ruapu.h
```

也支持二进制文件的下载：

```
下载 https://github.com/nihui/vkpeak/releases/download/20260527/vkpeak-20260527-windows.zip
```

只给个大概描述也行，DSH 会自动调用搜索 API, 不过速度可能稍慢：

```
下载 github 上的 ruapu.h
```

如果文件已经存在，会检测到并询问是否覆盖：

dsh-download-file README · 在 SKILL.md 中：下面是一个真实可用的 skill 例子: 安装 asan.cmake, 它位于 `C:/users/xxx/.dsh/skills/install-asan-cmake/SKILL.md`

```md
---
name: install-asan-cmake
description: 下载并安装 asan.cmake 到指定目录（默认当前目录），目标已存在时先询问是否更新。
---
dsh-download-file README · 安装 asan.cmake：下载源：`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zchrissirhcz/rocbuild/refs/heads/main/plugins/asan.cmake`

dsh-download-file README · 步骤：1. **目标目录**：用户指定则用之，否则取当前目录（不存在则创建）。
2. **已存在？**：每次执行都先用 `read`/`glob` **实际检查磁盘**目标路径是否已有 `asan.cmake`（**禁止凭对话历史判断**）。存在时才询问是否更新；回答「否」则跳过并说明未改动，回答「是」才覆盖。
3. **下载**：用 `download_file`，`url` 填下载源，`save_path` 填目标目录下的 `asan.cmake`（绝对路径）。`download_file` 返回的字节数即校验结果，**不要再额外读取校验**。

dsh-download-file README · 注意：- 内容原样落盘，不加工。
- 失败时说明原因，不写空文件。
- 未获确认不覆盖已有文件。
- 尽量减少工具调用轮次：每多一个回合就多一次 LLM 往返耗时。
```

---

dsh-download-file README · 参数速查：`download_file(url, save_path?, overwrite?)`

| 参数 | 必填 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `url` | 是 | 文件完整 URL（内网 GitLab raw、公网 GitHub 等任意 http/https） |
| `save_path` | 否 | 省略→当前工作目录（文件名取 URL 原始名）；以 `/` 结尾或指向已存在目录→作为目录；否则作为完整文件路径（自动建父目录） |
| `overwrite` | 否 | 文件已存在时：`false`（默认）→ 跳过、不覆盖；`true` → 覆盖 |

> 补充：URL 末尾没有文件名时（如 `https://x/`），会用 `download-<时间戳>` 当文件名，避免重名。

---

dsh-download-file README · 返回结果里有什么：**成功下载**：

```json
{ "ok": true, "url": "...", "saved_to": "E:\\proj\\configs\\xxxbuild.cmake",
  "bytes": 2048, "binary": false, "preview": "cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)\nproject(example)" }
```

- `saved_to`：文件实际落盘的绝对路径。
- `bytes`：字节数。
- `binary`：`false` 表示文本；`true` 表示二进制（图片、压缩包等）。
- `preview`：文件开头几行，用来确认内容对不对；二进制时是一句提示。

**文件已存在、默认没覆盖**：

```json
{ "ok": true, "skipped": true, "exists": true,
  "saved_to": "E:\\proj\\configs\\xxxbuild.cmake", "bytes": 2048 }
```

dsh-download-file README · 返回结果里有什么：模型看到 `skipped` 就知道没覆盖，会再来问你是否强制刷新。

---

dsh-download-file README · 常见场景：- **反复下载同一份配置** → 用默认（`overwrite: false`），不会覆盖已有文件；想刷新就加 `overwrite: true`。
- **下载二进制**（安装包、图片、压缩包）→ 同样支持，`binary: true`，字节原样保存。
- **下载公网文件**（GitHub 等）→ 和 GitLab 一样，直接传 URL。

---

dsh-download-file README · 和内置 web_fetch 的区别：| | `download_file`（本插件） | `web_fetch`（内置） |
|---|---|---|
| 用途 | **下载成文件**，落到磁盘 | **阅读网页**，返回正文给模型 |
| 内容 | 原始字节，二进制友好 | 提取正文，丢弃二进制 |
| 结果 | 文件路径 + 字节数 + 文本预览 | 摘要文本 |
| 大小 | 不限（流式） | 受上下文/抓取策略限制 |

一句话：要「拿回来一个文件」用 `download_file`，要「读一篇文章」用 `web_fetch`。

section: 和内置 web_fetch 的区别

text:
dsh-download-file README · 其他特性：- **磁盘级存在检查**：目标是否已存在以磁盘为准，默认不覆盖，避免静默覆盖。
- **逐字节原样保存**：文本换行符（`\n`/`\r\n`）、二进制字节均不转换、不丢失。
- **无大小上限**：流式写入，不把整个文件读进内存。
- **120 秒超时保护**：下载/写入卡死时自动中止，不会无限挂起。
- **写盘不弹授权**：在主机进程直接落盘，不需要逐次授权。
- **失败走 DSH 原生 `isError`**：网络/HTTP 错误作为工具失败返回，模型处理统一。

dsh-download-file README · 测试：```sh
npm test   # 等价于 node --test
```

14 个用例覆盖 `index.js` 的全部逻辑：下载核心（换行 / 二进制 / 大文件 / `save_path` 三态 / 磁盘存在检查 / 文件名回退 / 超时中止 / 空响应体）+ 插件接线（工具注册、`render` 三分支、`execute` 的 cwd 解析与回退），行覆盖接近 100%。

dsh-download-file README · dsh-download-file：**English | [中文](README.md)**

A DSH plugin that gives your Agent a **`download_file`** tool: download a file from any URL (intranet GitLab, public GitHub, etc.) to local disk — text or binary — and it shows you the first few lines of the file afterward. Pure ESM, zero dependencies, no build step, cross-platform (Windows / Linux / macOS).

dsh-download-file README · Purpose：One day I opened a fresh DSH (0.2.1-rc2) conversation:

> 下载 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nihui/ruapu/refs/heads/master/ruapu.h

DSH replied: `Error: spawn EPERM`.

I reopened a session and enabled "full permissions" for the working directory.

DSH said: `ruapu 是 nihui 的项目，我直接尝试下载。`

Two minutes passed and it still hadn't finished downloading. Frustrating.

That's why this plugin exists — **no full working-directory permissions needed, download done within 5 seconds**.

dsh-download-file README · Install：Command line:

```sh
dsh-download-file README · install from a local directory：dsh plugin --profile <profile> add file:./dsh-download-file

dsh-download-file README · or, after publishing to npm, install by package name：dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-download-file
```

GUI: DSH desktop → Plugins → enter `https://github.com/zchrissirhcz/dsh-download-file`.

section: or, after publishing to npm, install by package name

text:
dsh-download-file README · In a chat：Giving the exact URL is the fastest:

```
下载 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nihui/ruapu/refs/heads/master/ruapu.h
```

Binary files work too:

```
下载 https://github.com/nihui/vkpeak/releases/download/20260527/vkpeak-20260527-windows.zip
```

A rough description also works — DSH will call the search API automatically, though it can be a bit slower:

```
下载 github 上的 ruapu.h
```

If the file already exists, it is detected and DSH asks whether to overwrite:

dsh-download-file README · In SKILL.md：A real skill example — install asan.cmake, located at `C:/users/xxx/.dsh/skills/install-asan-cmake/SKILL.md`:

```md
---
name: install-asan-cmake
description: Download and install asan.cmake to the given directory (default: current dir); if the target exists, ask before updating.
---
dsh-download-file README · Install asan.cmake：Source: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zchrissirhcz/rocbuild/refs/heads/main/plugins/asan.cmake`

dsh-download-file README · Steps：1. **Target directory**: use the user-specified one, otherwise the current directory (created if missing).
2. **Already exists?**: each run, first use `read`/`glob` to actually check the disk for an existing `asan.cmake` (never judge from conversation history). Only ask about updating if it exists; "no" → skip and state nothing changed, "yes" → overwrite.
3. **Download**: use `download_file`, `url` = the source, `save_path` = absolute path to `asan.cmake` under the target directory. The byte count returned by `download_file` is the verification; don't re-read the file.

dsh-download-file README · Notes：- Save the content verbatim, no processing.
- On failure, explain why; don't write empty files.
- Don't overwrite existing files without confirmation.
- Keep tool-call rounds low: every extra round costs one more LLM round trip.
```

---

dsh-download-file README · Parameters：| Parameter | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `url` | yes | Full file URL (any http/https: intranet GitLab raw, public GitHub, etc.) |
| `save_path` | no | Omitted → current working directory (filename taken from the URL); ending in `/` or pointing to an existing directory → treated as a directory; otherwise → treated as a full file path (parent dirs auto-created) |
| `overwrite` | no | When the target already exists: `false` (default) → skip, do not overwrite; `true` → overwrite |

dsh-download-file README · Parameters：> Note: when the URL has no trailing filename (e.g. `https://x/`), it falls back to `download-<timestamp>` as the filename to avoid collisions.

---

dsh-download-file README · What the result contains：**Successful download**:

```json
{ "ok": true, "url": "...", "saved_to": "E:\\proj\\configs\\xxxbuild.cmake",
  "bytes": 2048, "binary": false, "preview": "cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)\nproject(example)" }
```

- `saved_to`: absolute path of the saved file.
- `bytes`: size in bytes.
- `binary`: `false` means text; `true` means binary (images, archives, etc.).
- `preview`: first few lines of the file, useful to confirm the content; for binary files it is a notice string.

dsh-download-file README · What the result contains：**File already exists and was not overwritten**:

```json
{ "ok": true, "skipped": true, "exists": true,
  "saved_to": "E:\\proj\\configs\\xxxbuild.cmake", "bytes": 2048 }
```

When the model sees `skipped`, it knows nothing was overwritten and will ask whether to force a refresh.

---

dsh-download-file README · Common scenarios：- **Repeatedly download the same config** → use the default (`overwrite: false`), existing files are kept; add `overwrite: true` to refresh.
- **Download binary files** (installers, images, archives) → supported the same way, `binary: true`, bytes preserved verbatim.
- **Download public files** (GitHub, etc.) → same as GitLab, just pass the URL.

---

dsh-download-file README · Difference from the built-in web_fetch：| | `download_file` (this plugin) | `web_fetch` (built-in) |
|---|---|---|
| Purpose | **Download as a file**, save to disk | **Read a page**, return the body to the model |
| Content | Raw bytes, binary-friendly | Extracts text, drops binary |
| Result | File path + byte count + text preview | Summarized text |
| Size | Unlimited (streamed) | Limited by context / fetch policy |

In short: want a **file** → `download_file`; want to **read an article** → `web_fetch`.

---

dsh-download-file README · Other features：- **Disk-based existence check**: whether the target exists is determined from the disk; existing files are not overwritten by default, avoiding silent data loss.
- **Byte-verbatim saving**: text line endings (`\n`/`\r\n`) and binary bytes are never transformed or lost.
- **No size limit**: streamed write, never loads the whole file into memory.
- **120s timeout guard**: a stuck download/write is aborted automatically instead of hanging forever.
- **No approval prompt on write**: writes directly in the host process, no per-operation authorization.
- **Failures use DSH's native `isError`**: network/HTTP errors are returned as tool failures, handled uniformly by the model.

dsh-download-file README · Tests：```sh
npm test   # equivalent to node --test
```

14 cases cover all of `index.js`: the download core (line endings / binary / large files / three-state `save_path` / disk existence check / filename fallback / timeout abort / empty body) plus the plugin wiring (tool registration, all three `render` branches, `execute`'s cwd resolution and fallback). Line coverage is near 100%.
